schedule: last trading day of completed W-FRI week
era_policy: SW2014 and SW2021 separate; no price path across gaps

A.persistence: at least 8 of last 10 sessions with acceleration > 0
A.diffusion: breadth21_t-breadth21_(t-21)>0; this change minus its value 21 sessions ago >0

B.finance_signal: quarterly revenue YoY change vs preceding quarter; positive prior-year base, nonnegative current revenue
B.availability: next trading day strictly after max(NOTICE_DATE,UPDATE_DATE) over all dependencies
B.missing_policy: retain full price universe in coverage; B ranks only common finance-available pool

evaluation.unknown: NaN; keep censored separate from path/classification gap
evaluation.primary_comparison: date paired complete selected cohorts, monthly equal weights
evaluation.uncertainty: 12 calendar-month circular blocks, 2000 bootstrap draws, seed33; exploratory

next_phase: independent validation or explicit new exploratory revision; no automatic data collection
